description.zh: 是否执行预检查。默认false。为true时，本次调用只会检查当前网格是否满足升级条件，并不会真正执行升级。
description.en: Specifies whether to perform a precheck. The default value is false. If this parameter is set to true, this operation checks whether the Service Mesh instance can be upgraded but does not perform the upgrade.
The ID of the ASM instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh upgrade-mesh-version --service-mesh-id c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --pre-check false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh UpgradeMeshVersion --region cn-hangzhou --ServiceMeshId c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --PreCheck false
